facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia made the Mobile Money Regulations, Amended 2020 (CBS/NBS/REG/06), under the Central Bank of Somalia Act 2012, setting out licensing, conduct of business and supervision of mobile money service providers; the document is dated 2020 and states no end date.

note: Only the arrangement of articles was held; it shows a licensing part but does not state that non-banks are licensed or that providers must connect, so no reach fact.
